summary: St. Joe NF butte lookout in Shoshone County: cab built 1922, cupola cabin 1925, destroyed in 1969; now gone, and no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Sources agree on the build-burn-replace-destroy chronology (1919, 1921, 1922, 1924, 1925, 1969). Coordinates: the brief's FFLA point is 47.02030, -115.80799 and its idaho_fl point is 47.02658, -115.80627, about 0.7 km apart; neither Idaho Fire Lookouts page we read prints coordinates, so the record was not changed. Elevation 6,994 ft comes from Idaho Fire Lookouts and has no schema key. The 1926 Monumental account and the Pete Snyder reminiscence (source 5) may refer to a different Monumental lookout, since the account names Priest River and Nordman; the story says so. The 1933 incident is a second-hand newspaper quote from source 4. Photos on sources 1 and 3 are credited to the Fire Lookout Museum but no image URLs were captured, so none are listed. No source describes current site access or remains.
